$comment: Contract version of this file, always equal to the schemaVersion const. Stable from 1.0.0-beta (docs/CONTRACTS.md).
title: Excubia health report
description: Version 1 of the JSON report. Upgrade steps never affect the process exit code. advisoryId is optional and exists so an ignore rule can name one advisory. generatedAt, excubiaVersion, project, licenses (#134), javascriptLockfile (#21), schedule (#146) and the per-finding fingerprint, advisoryId and details are optional, additive fields (#92), and so are release and deployedAt (#129), so schemaVersion stays 1; consumers must ignore fields they do not know. This schema covers --format=json only. --format=sarif follows the official SARIF 2.1.0 schema instead: one rule per checkId, one result per fail or warn finding (level error for critical and high, warning for medium, note for low and info), the Excubia severity, status, subject, advisoryId and evidenceUrl in result properties, the source manifest as a path relative to the scanned project, and a partialFingerprints entry built from checkId, subject and advisoryId. The upgrade plan is not part of the SARIF log.

generatedAt.description: When the checks ran, UTC, Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z.

excubiaVersion.description: The qiick/excubia-core version that produced the report, the same value as excubia --version (dev when Composer does not know it).

deployedAt.description: Set only by excubia push --deploy (and excubia:push --deploy): when the deploy was reported, UTC, Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z. The app draws a deploy marker for the release at this time.

javascriptLockfile.description: The JavaScript lockfile npm-advisories and dependency-licenses read (#21), relative to the project: the one of the packageManager in package.json when it exists, else the first present of pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock and package-lock.json. Omitted when the project has none. The SARIF location of npm findings is this file.

schedule.description: Schedule inventory of the booted app (#146): one entry per event of Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule, in schedule order, so excubia-app can flag a run that never happened, is late or failed by matching the runtime scheduledTask aggregates on taskId. Set by php artisan excubia:check and excubia:push only; the standalone CLI cannot boot the app and omits it. Excubia does not compute missed runs itself; each entry carries the grace the app applies (lateAfterMinutes).

environment.description: Optional (#203): the Laravel environment of the app (app.env), for example production or staging, set by php artisan excubia:check and excubia:push only; the standalone CLI omits it. A short name only, never a hostname: omitted when app.env does not match the pattern.

scheduledTask.description: One scheduled event. Never its arguments, command line, output path or user.

taskId.description: Stable id of a scheduled task (#146): sha256 of task, a NUL byte and the cron expression, lowercase hex. The same in the report schedule inventory and in the runtime scheduledTask aggregates, so a run matches its schedule entry.

task.description: Same naming as the runtime scheduledTask task (#109): the task description as set by the developer, with paths relative to the project (a file name outside it) and secrets masked as in exception messages; else artisan <command name> for an Artisan command or the executable's file name for an exec() task, without any argument; else Closure.

expression.description: The cron expression, five fields (or six with seconds when the app schedules sub-minute tasks).

timezone.description: IANA name (or offset) of the timezone the expression is read in: the task's own, else the schedule's (app.schedule_timezone or app.timezone), else the PHP default.

withoutOverlapping.description: The task uses withoutOverlapping(): a run is skipped while the previous one holds the lock.

onOneServer.description: The task uses onOneServer(): only one server runs each due time.

runsInMaintenanceMode.description: The task uses evenInMaintenanceMode(): it still runs while the app is down.

environments.description: Environment names the task is limited to (environments()); empty means all.

lateAfterMinutes.description: Optional: the user's grace for missed-run detection, from checks.laravel-scheduler-heartbeat.lateAfterMinutes (default 5). The app treats a due time with no run of this taskId within this many minutes as late. When absent, the app applies 5.

release.description: Release identifier of the deployed code: the release key of excubia.json, EXCUBIA_RELEASE, then GITHUB_SHA, CI_COMMIT_SHA, VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, FORGE_DEPLOY_COMMIT or LARAVEL_CLOUD_COMMIT, and for the standalone CLI only the commit checked out in the project's .git (read from the files, git is not run). Omitted when none is set or the first one set is not valid. Never a branch name, author or commit message.

project.description: Runtime and framework versions of the scanned project, each with the endoflife.date cycle it matched and the support end dates, present also when the end-of-life checks pass (#123). Versions only: no name, path or hostname (the app knows the project from its token). Each entry is null when the project does not declare that version. The dates come from the responses php-eol, laravel-eol and node-eol already fetched; when that check did not run (--skip, --only, node-eol disabled), was skipped (offline with no cache, data-source failure) or matched no cycle, cycle and the dates are null and version stays.

php.description: Resolved PHP version, as php-eol reads it: config.platform.php, then the lower bound of require.php, then platform.php in composer.lock.

node.description: Node declaration as written in .nvmrc, .node-version or package.json engines.node (a version or a range; Node has no lockfile entry). Null when absent or when it holds characters no version or range uses.

projectRuntime.description: One project entry: the version and its endoflife.date support window.

version.description: The version as described on the project property (unchanged from #92).

cycle.description: endoflife.date cycle the version matched (8.1, 10, 20), or null.

securitySupportEndsOn.description: End of security support, Y-m-d; null when unknown or when endoflife.date gives no date.

activeSupportEndsOn.description: End of active support (bug fixes), Y-m-d; null when unknown or when endoflife.date gives no date.

licenseInventory.description: License inventory of the packages dependency-licenses inspected (#134), present only when that check ran. Counts only, no package names: the findings carry those. Development dependencies are counted only with checks.dependency-licenses.includeDev. Ignore rules remove findings, never inventory counts.

licenseEcosystemInventory.description: License counts of one ecosystem: composer (composer.lock) or npm (the report's javascriptLockfile).

licenseCounts.description: Number of packages naming each license id, one entry per id sorted by id. A package with a choice counts once under each id it names; one that declares no license counts under NOASSERTION; an expression that does not parse counts as written.

license.description: SPDX license id as written in the lockfile (MIT, GPL-3.0-only, GPL-2.0+), or NOASSERTION.

advisoryId.description: Advisory id (Packagist advisory id or OSV id) on composer-advisories and npm-advisories findings. Omitted when the finding has none.

fingerprint.description: Stable identity of the finding across reports: lowercase hex sha256 of checkId, subject and advisoryId (empty string when absent) joined by a NUL byte. The SARIF partialFingerprints entry excubiaFinding/v1 carries the same value.

skipReason.description: Present on skipped findings only. data-source-failure: a data source failed (network down and no cache, or an API error); --strict makes the command exit 3. offline: --offline found no cached response. not-applicable: the check does not apply to the project or is disabled. Neither offline nor not-applicable ever changes the exit code. Optional and additive, so schemaVersion stays 1.

details.description: Check-specific values, so consumers do not parse message. Present only when the check sets any; the keys per checkId are fixed by the allOf rules of this definition. The private packages skip row of composer-advisories, npm-advisories, composer-abandoned, composer-stale, laravel-next-blocker, composer-outdated and npm-outdated carries privatePackagesDetails. Other skipped rows, and laravel-debug-mode, laravel-production-caches, laravel-maintenance-mode, laravel-app-key, laravel-session-security and laravel-log-level findings, carry no details.

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from composer.lock or package-lock.json.

affectedVersions.description: The advisory's affected range as a Composer constraint, as Packagist sends it.

fixedVersions.description: First fixed version of each affected range: the exclusive upper bound of every < in affectedVersions. Empty when no range has one (open or closed with <=).

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from the JavaScript lockfile.

fixedVersions.description: Always empty for now: the OSV batch answer carries vulnerability ids only. Kept so Composer and npm advisories share one shape.

lockfile.description: The JavaScript lockfile the package is locked in (#21, additive); the same value as the report's javascriptLockfile.

endOfLifeDetails.description: php-eol, laravel-eol and node-eol finding: the endoflife.date cycle the version matched.

securitySupportEndsOn.description: End of security support, Y-m-d; null when endoflife.date gives no date.

activeSupportEndsOn.description: End of active support (bug fixes), Y-m-d; null when endoflife.date gives no date.

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from composer.lock or package-lock.json.

replacement.description: Replacement package Packagist suggests; null when none is suggested.

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from composer.lock or package-lock.json.
Locked version from composer.lock or package-lock.json.

targetMajor.description: The Laravel major the package does not allow yet (locked major plus one).

privatePackagesDetails.description: The skipped private packages row (subject private packages).

count.description: Number of private packages not sent to the data source.
Number of failed jobs in the failed job store.

oldestAgeHours.description: Whole hours since the oldest failed job failed; null when unknown.

minutesSinceLastRun.description: Whole minutes since the last excubia:heartbeat; null when the scheduler never ran it.

dependencyLicensesDetails.description: dependency-licenses finding: a denied (fail, high), strong copyleft (warn, medium) or missing or unknown (warn, low) license.

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from composer.lock or package-lock.json.

licenses.description: License entries the lockfile declares, each an SPDX id or expression as written (Composer's license array, npm's license field). More than one entry is a choice. Empty when none is declared. Entries with characters SPDX never uses are left out.

ecosystem.description: Lockfile the package comes from: composer (composer.lock) or npm (the report's javascriptLockfile). yarn.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml record no licenses: their npm packages without one get no row and are not counted in the inventory; one skipped row (not-applicable, subject the lockfile, no details) counts them.

kind.description: Optional (#204): why the license was flagged, so an app need not infer it from status and severity. denied: in checks.dependency-licenses.denied (fail, high); copyleft: a strong copyleft license (warn, medium); unknown: none declared or not a known permitted license (warn, low). Set on every finding from 1.0.0-beta.4; reports from older versions omit it.

hasCredentials.description: True when cors.supports_credentials is on as well (the fail row).

component.description: The component whose default driver is meant for local work.

driver.description: The driver name, always one of the flagged development drivers.

package.description: Composer name of the development tool listed in require and enabled.

databaseDetails.description: laravel-database finding, one per connection that did not answer.

connection.description: Connection name from config/database.php; never the host or DSN.

store.description: Name of the default cache store from config/cache.php.

directory.description: The framework directory that is not writable, relative to the app.

usedPercent.description: Used share of the disk holding storage/, in whole percent (rounded down).

queueBacklogDetails.description: laravel-queue-backlog finding, one per queue over a threshold.

queue.description: Queue name on the default queue connection.

pendingCount.description: Jobs waiting to be picked up (not reserved, not delayed).

oldestAgeMinutes.description: Whole minutes the oldest pending job has waited; null when unknown (a Redis payload without createdAt).

platformRequirementsDetails.description: php-platform-requirements finding, one per unmet requirement.

requirement.description: php or an ext-* name, lowercase, as in composer.lock.

requiredBy.description: Locked package names whose require is not met, or composer.json for the root platform requirements.

checkedPhpVersion.description: Version of the PHP the check ran on (major.minor.release).

isStandaloneCli.description: True when vendor/bin/excubia ran the check: its PHP can differ from the app's. False under Artisan.

envExampleMissingKeyDetails.description: env-example-sync finding for a key that config/*.php reads but .env.example does not list, one per key. Key names only, never a value.

key.description: Environment variable name read with env() in the config files.

configFiles.description: Project-relative config files that read the key, such as config/services.php.

envExampleUnusedKeysDetails.description: env-example-sync summary row (subject unused keys, severity info) for the keys .env.example lists that no config file reads.

keys.description: The unused key names, sorted. Never a value.

outdatedDetails.description: composer-outdated and npm-outdated finding, one per direct dependency with a newer release. Versions are as Packagist or the npm registry prints them. Only stable releases count, unless lockedVersion is a pre-release.

lockedVersion.description: Locked version from composer.lock, or from the JavaScript lockfile for npm-outdated.

latestPatch.description: Newest release with the locked major and minor; null when none is newer than the lock.

latestMinor.description: Newest release with the locked major; null when none is newer than the lock.

latestMajor.description: Newest release of a later major; null when there is none.

queueWorkerHeartbeatDetails.description: laravel-queue-workers finding without Laravel Horizon, one per queue that has pending jobs and no recent worker heartbeat. Connection and queue names only, never a hostname.

connection.description: Name of the default queue connection.

minutesSinceLastSeen.description: Whole minutes since a worker last reported on this queue (heartbeat cache key excubia:worker-heartbeat:<connection>:<queue>); null when none ever did.

horizonStatusDetails.description: laravel-queue-workers finding with Laravel Horizon installed (subject horizon), when Horizon is inactive or paused.

status.description: Horizon's status, as php artisan horizon:status reports it.

processes.description: Worker processes of all Horizon supervisors.

supervisors.description: Supervisor names from config/horizon.php, without the master supervisor prefix (which carries the hostname), sorted.

backupDestinationDetails.description: laravel-backups finding, one per spatie/laravel-backup destination that has no backup, cannot be reached, has a newest backup that is too old, or shrank by more than half. The disk name only, never a path, bucket or credential.

disk.description: Filesystem disk name from config/filesystems.php, as config/backup.php lists it.

ageHours.description: Whole hours since the newest backup was made; null when there is none or the destination could not be reached.

sizeMb.description: Size of the newest backup in MiB, two decimals; null when there is none or the destination could not be reached.

count.description: Backups on the destination; null when it could not be reached.

databaseConnectionsDetails.description: laravel-database-connections finding, when the default connection has more open connections than warnAt.

connection.description: Name of the default connection from config/database.php; never the host or DSN.

connectionCount.description: Open connections: Threads_connected on the MySQL or MariaDB server, pg_stat_activity rows for the PostgreSQL database.

databaseSizeDetails.description: laravel-database-size finding: a pass row at info, or a medium warning above checks.laravel-database-size.warnAtMb.

connection.description: Name of the default connection from config/database.php; never the database name, host or file path.

sizeMb.description: Size of the default database in MB (1 MB = 1048576 bytes), rounded to two decimals. SQLite: the size of the database file.

largestTables.description: Up to five largest tables, largest first. Empty when the catalog cannot be read (SQLite without the dbstat table).

sizeMb.description: Data and index size of the table in MB, rounded to two decimals.

redisMemoryDetails.description: laravel-redis-memory finding, one per Redis connection that is near or at its maxmemory, has no maxmemory, or holds the cache with the noeviction policy. The connection name only, never a host, port or password.

usedMb.description: used_memory from INFO memory in MiB, two decimals.

maxMb.description: maxmemory in MiB, two decimals; null when it is 0 (unbounded).

policy.description: maxmemory_policy (noeviction, allkeys-lru, …); null when the server does not report it.

phpOpcacheDetails.description: php-opcache finding. Booleans, percentages and a count only, never an ini file or script path.

sapi.description: The PHP SAPI the values come from: always web, the snapshot the health endpoint stores at most once an hour. The CLI that runs Artisan is never reported: without a web snapshot the check is skipped.

ageMinutes.description: Minutes since the health endpoint stored the web snapshot.

isOpcacheEnabled.description: OPcache is enabled for the web SAPI.

hitRate.description: OPcache hits over hits plus misses, in percent with two decimals; null when OPcache is disabled or has no lookup yet.

memoryUsedPercent.description: Used plus wasted OPcache shared memory, in percent with two decimals; null when OPcache is disabled.

cachedScripts.description: Scripts in the OPcache; null when OPcache is disabled.

phpProductionIniDetails.description: php-production-ini finding, one per directive. A boolean only, never the ini value or file path.

sapi.description: The PHP SAPI the values come from: always web, the snapshot the health endpoint stores at most once an hour. The CLI that runs Artisan is never reported: without a web snapshot the check is skipped.

ageMinutes.description: Minutes since the health endpoint stored the web snapshot.

laravelOctaneConfigDetails.description: laravel-octane-config finding (#213): the info row with the server type, and in production the max_requests warning. Names and integers only.

server.description: octane.server: swoole, roadrunner or frankenphp, else unknown.

maxRequests.description: octane.max_requests, null when it is not set (or not an integer).

laravelReverbDetails.description: laravel-reverb finding (#215): whether a TCP connect to the host and port of the Reverb broadcast connection succeeded within 2 s. A boolean and milliseconds only: never the host or the port.

latencyMs.description: How long the TCP connect took, in ms with 1 decimal; null when it failed.
